messages:
maya_sales: Heads-up — AcmePay raised a support ticket: their p95 latency jumped ~1s for chat endpoints after the Friday rollout. They say it impacts checkout flows and want a mitigation ASAP.

jordan_support: Echoing — support ticket #45321 with traces attached. Errors are low, just sustained tail latency on /v1/chat.generate. Customer provided request_ids: r_8a3..., r_f12...

alex_pm: How bad vs their SLA? Do we classify P0 or P1? They mentioned they may delay go-live next week.

maya_sales: They’re contractually on a 200ms p95 target for that route. Right now they’re at ~1200ms p95. Sales is getting pressure.

li_eng: Looking at graphs from observability — spike correlates with the new batching config +slo-batching-2 that shipped Friday. p50 unchanged but p95 and p99 up.

sam_oncall: deploybot reported the canary passed, but the canary traffic was low. Oncall dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/acmepay-chat?orgId=1 — p95 jumped at 2026-03-20T14:12Z.

alex_pm: Ok classify as customer-impacting (SLA breach risk). Options: 1) rollback batching tweak, 2) route AcmePay to dedicated pool or older model variant, 3) temporary throttling/queueing. Prioritize effort level and time-to-ship.

li_eng: Quick eval: rollback batching tweak is a ~1hr change + canary verification. Routing to dedicated pool requires capacity check + ~2-4 hrs to provision/pin if no spare capacity. Pinning older model version for that customer is possible: simple API flag but needs infra gating and auth check ~2-3 hrs.

jordan_support: Customer asked for ETA within 4 hours.

maya_sales: If we can offer pin-to-previous-model + service credit until fixed, that might keep them from pausing rollout. They want minimal runtime changes on their side.

li_eng: Minimal action plan: A) roll back batching config in runtime (fast), B) prepare route-to-previous-model playbook (ready if rollback doesn't hit target), C) coordinate with sales for messaging. I can take A. Need someone from eng-platform for B.

sam_oncall: I’ll run the rollback canary on staging then small prod canary. Deploybot: can we trigger a rollback job?
deploybot: @sam_oncall — rollback job queued: job_id=rb-246824-01. Watch logs: /deploys/rb-246824-01

alex_pm: Assigning tasks: li_eng -> rollback batching (estimate 60–90m). eng-platform (cc @eng-platform) -> prepare pinning route and capacity check (ETA 2–4h). jordan_support -> keep collecting traces and update ticket. maya_sales -> messaging and negotiate temporary SLA leniency. sam_oncall -> run canary + monitor.

maya_sales: I’ll tell AcmePay we’re escalating and propose pinning to previous model instantly if needed; ask them to standby for a 2–4h fix window.

li_eng: Starting rollback now. Will post status updates and perf numbers.

sam_oncall: Canary started on a tiny subset (0.5%). Metrics link: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/canary-rb-246824. Will report p95 in 15m.

jordan_support: Uploaded additional request traces to ticket and flagged sample IDs to eng: r_8a3..., r_f12..., r_b77...

li_eng: Canary looks promising — p95 dropped from ~1200ms to ~210ms on canary traffic. Scheduling staged rollout to 20%, then 60%, then 100% if stable.

alex_pm: Great. Product note: we need a backlog ticket to triage why batching change regresses tail for certain request shapes. Add launch criteria: require p95 non-regression on representative enterprise customers in canary before batching config flips.

maya_sales: Customer accepted the plan and paused escalation as long as we keep them updated every 30m.

sam_oncall: Staged rollout progressing, no error increase. p95 converging to ~230ms across traffic.

alex_pm: Closing the immediate fire — li_eng will follow up with a root-cause postmortem and a proposed conservative rollout policy (canary traffic thresholds + customer-specific checks). jordan_support, please close the ticket after confirming with customer.

li_eng: Will open PR with detailed repro steps and add a test in the performance suite for long-tail requests.

jordan_support: Confirmed with AcmePay — they remain on watch but not pausing rollout. Closing internal ticket now.

alex_pm: Thanks team. Action items recap (add to product backlog): [rollback done], RCA + perf test, rollout policy change, customer comms template, roadmap item to improve canary coverage for enterprise customers.

maya_sales: Thx all — will update account notes and follow up with contract team about temporary SLA credit if needed. :thumbsup:

sam_oncall: Marking incident resolved in oncall and leaving monitoring alerts at elevated priority for 24h.

li_eng: Posting final logs and PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/abcd1234 — will assign reviewers.
